title: Money columns always show invoiced amounts, never the outstanding balance
custom_preconds: 1. A partially-paid ZZAUTOTEST invoice exists with a known full Subtotal and a known partial payment.
custom_steps: 1. Filter to "Partially Paid," expand the owning rep, and read that invoice's money columns.
custom_expected:
1. The invoice shows its FULL invoiced amounts (its full Subtotal) — payments are not netted out.
2. Filtering to "Unpaid" or "Partially Paid" changes which invoices are included, never the amounts shown.
